diagnosed_issues: Hero desktop container capped at max-h-[380px] with pb-14 and bottom-2.5 tab dock causes vertical crowding and left/right arrow overlap.
Hero text overlay snaps with 0ms change while only background crossfades; zero Ken Burns depth, zero progress indicator on active tab, and empty right 45% dark gradient scrim.
Frequent transition-all on cards/controls triggers layout/paint recalculation instead of GPU-composited transform + opacity with broadcast ease cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
Lazy content-visibility: auto + double-layer BlurProductImage + backdrop-blur inside overflow-x-auto horizontal carousels introduces scroll jitter on mobile/trackpad swipes.
Carousel left/right buttons are opacity-0 until hover (undiscoverable on touch/trackpad), and filter tab switching snaps instantaneously with 0ms feedback.
